purpose: fixed workshop12 base ability; the later fixed-history to mutant adaptation branches start from these checkpoints

goal.sampling: on each goal success or world reset, command a goal that is false in the current observation and not yet in seen_goals
goal.reward: 1 exactly on the first action transition that makes the commanded predicate true; otherwise 0
goal.after_success: do not reset the world; cut bootstrap and GAE, then sample the next false unseen goal

rng_initialization: jax.random.PRNGKey(learner_seed) is split once into model initialization, action, environment, and sampler streams; per-worker environment and sampler keys are then split by worker index
budget_accounting: all physical environment transitions, including post-success loss-masked NOOPs, count toward the raw transition budget

model.shared: one 512-unit dense layer, orthogonal sqrt(2), ReLU
model.actor: two 512-unit dense hidden layers, ReLU, then 20-logit output with orthogonal 0.01
model.critic: four 512-unit dense hidden layers, ReLU, then sigmoid scalar output with orthogonal 1.0

checkpoint.contents: model, optimizer, learner RNG, worker states and RNGs, current goals and command progress, oracle/provenance state, sampler RNG, seen goals, counters, rollout cursor, no-op normalization state, schedule position, and full config
checkpoint.resume: a restarted cell loads the newest checkpoints/update_K with K < 512 and continues in the same directory; it does not start a new seed from update 0 when that checkpoint exists

evaluation.note: this frozen probe is the existing deliver_3 validation evaluation; it is not the 12-goal base-ability table
evaluation.frozen_state: learner bytes are compared before and after evaluation

execution.gpu: seed 0 on CUDA device 0; seeds 1 then 2 on CUDA device 1
execution.cpu: seeds 0, 1, 2 in order, only when no workshop12 trainer is alive
execution.shared_tree: GPU and CPU queues use the same directories and resume rule

completion_criterion: all three fixed seeds finish update 512 and each leaves the five checkpoints at updates 0, 32, 128, 256, and 512; there is no performance threshold
scope_limits: mutant adaptation is not part of this queue
GPU and CPU bitwise equality is not claimed
PACK-RESTORE is not part of this queue
